inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Video footage from 8/17/2026 captured a caregiver not washing infants' hands after diapering.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: Based on video footage from 8/17/2026, a caregiver was observed not washing their hands before and after diaper changes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: In the preschool room, children were observed watching a Mickey Mouse cartoon during lunch from the tablet. .   Noted: this was corrected during the inspection when the tablet was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Parent's Written Permission for Powders, Lotions, Etc.: Diaper creams were not labeled with the children's names but rather "twins."
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Parent's Written Permission for Powders, Lotions, Etc. (26 TAC §746.3501(4))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: The large playground was littered with discarded  water cups  on the ground throughout the playground. Children were observed picking up the trash and throwing it over the fence. It is also noted that there were discarded garbage bags in front of a shed that stores outdoor toys that children are able to access.   Noted: this was corrected during the inspection when the trash was picked up and discarded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The bottom of the metal door stopper had a screw that was protruding, creating a hazard.      I observed on corner of the small playground water hose, metal frame, tarp,  cot and trash.      Ants were observed on the corner of the small playground on a tarp.        Note:  During inspection caregiver removed the screw.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's product form has not been re-certified.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Location of Handwashing Sink: Hand soap and paper towels were not independently accessible to children at the Preschool hand sinks. This was corrected at inspection when a soap dispenser was provided and hand towels were stocked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.4405)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Three of ten children's records audited did not have current immunizations and two did not have current health statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose-fill under the play structures on the Pre-K playground and the dual slides in the Toddler playground were less than six-inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Crib Activities: Upon review of video footage provided, it was observed that an infant was placed in their crib awake and remained awake in the crib for over 30 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Crib Activities (26 TAC §746.2425)

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs: Upon review of video footage provided, a caregiver was observed picking up an approximately 7-week-old infant out of their crib, and walking across the room, failing to support the infant's neck.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs (26 TAC §746.2401(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Using Harsh, Abusive or Profane Language: At time of inspection a prek caregiver was observed yelling in a childs face.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: At time of inspection, a prek caregiver stated they had twelve children but class had thirteen.     A time of inspection a early preschool caregiver stated to have nine children but class had eight.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: At time of inspection a PreKinder caregiver did not know the number of children they were caring for.     At time of inspection a PreKinder caregiver did not know the ages of children caring for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: At time of insepction transportation training for staff who provides service expired on 5.28.24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: At time of inspection a diaper changing station in a preschool class was observed to have debris.     At time of inspection multiple handwashing sinks were observed to be stained.     At time of inspection a childrens restroom door was observed to have a hole at the bottom of the door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
